A1.justification: Both PDFs describe SocialHarmBench and contain the complete 45-page paper, including Appendices A–H. Text and rendered-page comparisons establish that the scientific content, figures, tables, and equations match.

before.justification: v1 reports original evaluations of eight LLMs, adversarial attack experiments, temporal and geographic analyses, and training-data attribution results in Section 4 and Appendices G–H.

after.justification: v2 retains the original model evaluations, adversarial experiments, temporal and geographic analyses, and attribution results reported in v1.

M1.justification: The benchmark construction pipeline, dual-classifier evaluation procedure, attack implementations, and EK-FAC attribution method are unchanged in Sections 2–4 and Appendices D–H.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same 585 English prompts covering seven domains, 37 subtopics, and 34 countries. Historical and geographic scenarios and the weight-tampering training dataset are unchanged.

E2.justification: The same eight models appear in the baseline comparisons. Adversarial comparisons retain the same five open-weight models and GCG, AutoDAN-GA, AutoDAN-HGA, LAT, weight-tampering, and embedding attacks.

E3.justification: Section 3 and Appendix F retain identical evaluation metrics, model configurations, attack budgets, generation settings, and finetuning hyperparameters. The attribution analysis still uses 70 prompts sampled evenly across the seven domains.

E4.justification: The adversarial robustness comparisons, category breakdowns, temporal and geographic analyses, qualitative examples, and influence-function case study are identical, including their appendix evidence.

E5.justification: Both versions specify deterministic seed 20 for PyTorch, NumPy, and CUDA in Appendix F.2. Neither changes repeated-run information or adds confidence intervals, significance tests, or uncertainty estimates.

E6.justification: All numerical results and qualitative findings match, including Appendices G–H. For example, Table 4 retains Mistral's combined HB/SR scores of 27.71%/28.31%, and Table 11 retains its weight-tampering HB score of 0.9576.

T1.justification: The over-representation-factor definition in Appendix E.3, attack objectives in Appendix F.1, and influence-function/EK-FAC equations (1)–(3) in Appendix H.1 are unchanged. No mathematical assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same benchmark novelty claim and conclusions about sociopolitical vulnerabilities, effective jailbreaks, and temporal and regional variation.

C2.justification: Interpretations of model vulnerabilities and training-data attribution are unchanged. Appendix B retains the same limitations concerning geographic imbalance, English-only coverage, omitted attack settings, ambiguous prompts, and classifier errors.

D1.justification: Appendices A, D–F, and H retain identical reproducibility and implementation information. Dataset and code link targets are unchanged; removing a stray period from their footnote does not change access information.

R1.justification: Table 1, Section 5, and the reference list retain the same cited works and research positioning. The updated publication header does not revise the paper's relationship to prior research.

P1.justification: The running header changes from 'Preprint 2025' to 'Published as a conference paper at ICLR 2026'; the arXiv version/date stamp is updated, and a stray period is removed from the first-page resource footnote. Body prose and document structure are unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures, tables, captions, axes, legends, and their placement are identical throughout both PDFs. The header and arXiv-stamp wording updates do not alter the page layout.

improvement.justification: v2 updates publication/version markings and corrects footnote punctuation. The scientific content, evidence, explanations, limitations, and reproducibility information remain identical, so these cosmetic edits produce no meaningful overall quality difference.
